task.title: To add a new Favorite Filter
task.shortdesc: When a Search & Select or Query action executes that requires input from the runtime

context.p: When a Search & Select or Query action executes that requires input from the runtime user, and Favorite Filters are enabled, the user can create a filter as normal and add it as a new, reusabled filter.

step.cmd: Open an app and retrieve data that requires user input (Search & Select or Query screen).
From the action window, search for and filter the list of retrieved data.
Click on the Favorite Filter drop-down and select Add...
In the Add Filter dialog, enter a name for your Favorite Filter and click OK.
Select the new filter from the drop-down. Your filter is now saved and can be reused for any enabled action.
